discovery_notes: Follow-up to packet 260 (b088), reusing its keys. 30 standard search-snippet queries. FiGPiN Child #507/#510 and Winter Soldier #715 from retailer listings; Falcon and Wanda date conflicts remain. Funko Walmart Princess pin_structure holds released (Walmart 4pc listing names the four princesses); Mandalorian Walmart members still unknown. Numskull Mandalorian scope hold released (metal pins). Lock Shock Barrel kept on hold (HT Loungefly set of 3 linked by name only). Toynk 500 vs 1000 explained as two products; new SDCC 2021 B&W set. New: Her Universe 2020 holiday pin, FiGPiN Marvel Comics Series 3 (4), What If series 1 (4), Boba Fett #734/#737. Hot Topic makers: Loungefly for 9 of 10 (Steamboat Willie unresolved). Key slugs hot-topic-* kept as in packet 260 though maker now Loungefly.
